sparql_or_graph_query: MATCH (p:Resource), (m:Resource), (f:Resource) WHERE p['zs_POI_dm.gid'] IS NOT NULL AND m['zs_MP_bz.gid'] IS NOT NULL AND f['zs_FJ_bz.gid'] IS NOT NULL AND p['zs_POI_dm.BZ_GUID'] = m['zs_MP_bz.GUID'] AND m['zs_MP_bz.S_GUID'] = f['zs_FJ_bz.S_GUID'] RETURN p['zs_POI_dm.DLMC'] AS dlmc, count(*) AS room_cnt ORDER BY room_cnt DESC
